name: Hong Kong Metropolitan University
summary: Ho Man Tin university with a direct route for non-local applicants; two science and technology degrees state English as the language of instruction.

ib.text: IB Diploma with an overall minimum of 24 points, and grade 4 or above in IB English. An interview is normally required. Programmes may add subjects.

lastYear.text: 1st round to 31 Mar; final round to 31 May

programmes.name: Cyber and Computer Security
programmes.about: A computing degree on cyber security that builds knowledge of hardware, software, infrastructure and professional practice; the page states English as the language of instruction.

needs.note: Grade 4 or above in IB English

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on IB results; an interview is normally required. Applications are rolling and may close early once places are filled.

programmes.name: Electronic and Computer Engineering
programmes.about: An engineering degree with core courses in electronic and computer engineering, then specialisation in mobile and wireless networks, signal processing, biomedical technologies, digital multimedia or software; taught in English.

needs.note: Grade 4 or above in IB English

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on IB results; an interview is normally required. Applications are rolling and may close early once places are filled.

notes: Applications for 2027 entry are not dated yet; last year they ran on a rolling basis and could close early once places were filled, so apply as early as you can.
HKMU teaches each degree in one main language; only these two state English on their pages, so ask admissions which other degrees run in English before you apply.
Hong Kong sets no EU rate: HKMU's non-local tuition was HK$111,490 to HK$118,370 a year for these degrees in 2026/27, and 2027/28 is not published yet.
